reason: A Web-only DeepSeek Harness plugin for favoriting Sessions and reopening them from a global cross-Workspace panel, with browser-local storage and no network requests described.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中收藏会话，并通过跨工作区的全局收藏面板重新打开可用会话。
summaries.en: Favorite DeepSeek Harness Web Sessions and reopen available ones from a global cross-workspace favorites panel.

capabilities: Adds favorite controls and a cross-workspace favorites panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web interface
Stores Session identifiers and favorite timestamps in browser localStorage
Synchronizes favorites across same-origin browser tabs via the storage event
Reopens available live Sessions and marks unavailable saved Sessions for removal
